name: hero-split
description: Split-layout hero with text on one side and image/media on the other, ideal for product showcases

ai.whenToUse: Use for landing pages and product pages where you want a side-by-side layout with text and an image or illustration. Great for SaaS, agency, and portfolio sites that need to show a product screenshot or visual alongside the value proposition.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use when the hero needs a full-width background image or gradient. Avoid on mobile-first content sites where a stacked layout is better handled by hero-gradient.

headline.description: Primary headline displayed on the text side

subheadline.example: Build, launch, and scale your product with the tools that modern teams trust.

imageAlt.description: Alt text for the hero image
